country.name: Burundi
country.jurisdictionNotice: Preschool, fundamental, post-fundamental, trades and vocational training, and higher education use distinct cycles, directorates and authorization records. BRASA must preserve the responsible authority, provincial and communal education geography, institution, programme and effective period.
country.languagePolicy: Kirundi, French and English have distinct official, instructional and curriculum roles. Kiswahili and community language needs must be recorded without treating automatic translation as reviewed localization.

review.policy: No category becomes verified without a named qualified Burundian reviewer, current authoritative evidence and review by the responsible ministry, provincial or communal education authority, institution, privacy regulator or child-protection authority.

governanceModel.summary: The Ministry of National Education and Scientific Research governs the education continuum through distinct programmes and directorates. Provincial and communal education directorates, vocational structures, higher-education authorities and the National Commission for Higher Education have different records and decisions.
governanceModel.schoolRule: Preserve the official school name, DPE and DCE or successor territorial units, commune, locality, sector, level, cycle, status, source census date and review date. Statistical enumeration does not by itself prove current authorization or operation.
governanceModel.higherEducationRule: Institutional approval, public or private status, exact programme authorization, degree authority, institutional quality evaluation, suspension from first-year recruitment, site, modality and current status are separate claims.

authorities.name: Ministry of National Education and Scientific Research
authorities.role: national education policy, programmes, administration, statistics and higher education within its current organization

authorities.name: Provincial and communal education directorates
authorities.role: territorial school administration, records and statistical reporting

authorities.name: Directorates responsible for fundamental and post-fundamental programmes
authorities.role: curriculum design, implementation and support by cycle and stream

authorities.name: Authorities responsible for trades and vocational training
authorities.role: centres of trades, vocational-training centres and technical/vocational programmes

authorities.name: Directorate General for Higher Education and National Commission for Higher Education
authorities.role: higher-education institution, programme and quality-assurance decisions within their mandates

authorities.name: Education planning and statistics office
authorities.role: official statistical yearbooks by education subsector

authorities.name: Competent personal-data protection authority under Law No. 1/03 of 10 March 2026
authorities.role: data-protection supervision under the new law

authorities.name: Ministry responsible for national solidarity, child and family protection
authorities.role: child protection, participation, referral and assistance within its current mandate

curriculum.authority: Competent MENRS programme directorate according to cycle and stream
curriculum.title: Burundi official programmes for fundamental, post-fundamental and vocational education
curriculum.implementationRule: Confirm cycle, year or class, subject, general, pedagogical, technical or vocational stream, official programme, approving instrument, edition, language, experimental or implementation status and effective school year. A reform history, workshop, evaluation or planned experiment is not the controlling current programme.
curriculum.supplementPolicy: Programme, teacher guide, textbook, examination specification, curriculum reform, experiment and external resource are distinct layers and must not silently replace one another.

schoolDirectory.authority: MENRS and responsible provincial and communal education directorates
schoolDirectory.scopeNotice: Official statistical yearbooks enumerate schools and education structures by subsector and territorial unit at a stated census date. A verified current public school-search interface or unified national directory covering every preschool, fundamental, post-fundamental, technical, vocational, public, communal and private institution was not located. Statistical tables must retain the census date and cannot silently establish current operation.
requiredRecordFields: official institution name and identifier when published
DPE and DCE or current successor units
authorization or recognition evidence when published

educationStatistics.authority: MENRS education planning and statistics office
educationStatistics.scopeNotice: Every figure must preserve the census date, school or academic year, subsector, cycle definition, public, communal or private coverage, DPE/DCE geography and publication date. A file uploaded in 2024 or 2025 containing 2022–2023 observations is not current 2025 data.

higherEducationAndTVET.authority: MENRS, the National Commission for Higher Education and competent vocational authorities within their mandates
higherEducationAndTVET.authorityNotice: Appearance on an institution list or a historical approval date does not authorize every current programme or prove accreditation. Institutional quality-evaluation scores are not programme accreditation. Verify the exact institution, programme, degree authority, site, modality, approval decision, recruitment suspension or restriction, effective academic year and current status.

privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionLaw: Law No. 1/03 of 10 March 2026 on protection of personal data
privacyAndSafeguarding.childrenFramework: Convention on the Rights of the Child as ratified by Burundi, national child-protection mandates, and applicable current national laws and procedures
privacyAndSafeguarding.scopeNotice: The 2026 data-protection law is new. Its commencement, supervisory authority, implementing measures, lawful bases, sensitive and biometric data rules, learner rights, transfers, retention and prior formalities require qualified review. Child safeguarding, consent or participation, referral, assistance-line, school incident and violence-response duties require current consolidated national texts and procedures; a ministry mandate alone is not the complete safeguarding framework.

culturalAndLanguageRequirements.rule: Kirundi, French, English and Kiswahili have distinct official, instructional, curriculum and community contexts. First-cycle fundamental instruction in Kirundi and later multilingual transitions must remain attached to the exact cycle, subject, approved material and current policy. Preserve exact language, orthography, level, school model, accessibility need and qualified community review.

completionCriteria: A qualified Burundian education reviewer is named.
National, provincial, communal, curriculum, vocational, higher-education, privacy and child-protection responsibilities are correctly assigned.
A verified unified current public school-directory source is documented or the directory gap remains visibly disclosed.
Every school record preserves DPE/DCE or successor units, commune, subsector, cycle, status, census date and review date.
Every statistic preserves census date and school or academic year separately from upload or publication date.
Curriculum mappings preserve cycle, class, subject, stream, language, approving text, version and effective year; workshops and experiments are not treated as controlling programmes.
Every higher-education claim separately verifies institution, programme, degree authority, site, modality, quality decision, recruitment restriction and current status.
Kirundi, French, English, Kiswahili and community needs are represented according to their distinct educational contexts.
The new 2026 privacy law and current child-protection procedures are reviewed before a real learner pilot.
No authorization, recognition, accreditation, partnership or credential claim exceeds documentary evidence.
